world: Stocked suite S10: Sweep: headcount changes

scenario.name: Priya changes mind: one refund, one top-up
scenario.opening_message: It's Priya. Take me off the dinner at Luca's, I can't make it.
scenario.instruction: You are Priya. Cancel on the dinner. Once confirmed, say you can come after all and ask to be added back.
criteria: The agent takes Priya off and reports the refund.
When Priya rejoins, the agent adds them back and reports the extra charge.

rubric.name: Priya changes mind: one refund, one top-up

turns.user: It's Priya. Take me off the dinner at Luca's, I can't make it.
turns.agent: Done, Priya — you're off Luca's. The party is now 3 (Maya, Sam, Leo), the ride switched to transit, and it works out to $34.50 each.

turns.user: Actually, my plans just changed and I can make it after all. Can you add me back to the dinner at Luca's?
turns.agent: You're back in, Priya — party of 4 again (Maya, Sam, Leo, you), the ride is a cab, and it's $34.00 each.

rubric.name: Sam changes mind: one refund, one top-up

turns.user: It's Sam. Take me off the dinner at Luca's, I can't make it.
turns.agent: Done, Sam — you're off Luca's. The party is now 3 (Maya, Priya, Leo), the ride switched to transit, and each remaining person pays $34.50.

turns.user: Actually, good news, I can come after all. Can you add me back to the dinner at Luca's?
turns.agent: You're back in, Sam — all 4 going to Luca's again, cab ride restored, and each person pays $34.00.

scenario.name: Priya drops out: one refund
scenario.opening_message: Hey, it's Priya. I can't make the dinner at Luca's anymore.
scenario.instruction: You are Priya. Say you can't make the dinner. Ask what happens to the booking and the money.
criteria: The agent records that Priya is out and says the booking was updated.
The agent states the refund or the new cost per person.

turns.user: Hey, it's Priya. I can't make the dinner at Luca's anymore.
turns.agent: Done, Priya — you're off the Luca's dinner. The party is now 3 (Maya, Sam, Leo), the ride switched to transit, and each person pays $34.50. Want me to email the updated details to the group?

turns.user: Thanks. Does the booking stay as is for the other three? And what happens to my share of the money, do I owe anything or get something back?
turns.agent: Yes, the booking stands for Maya, Sam and Leo — party of 3 at Luca's with transit. On your money: the re-plan charged the difference once, so you don't owe anything more; the system handles any refund of your old share automatically rather than me moving it by hand.
